summary: Completed testing of iteration 16 features for BillHub financial services app. All 5 requested features tested and verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 16 features verified: 1) Case-insensitive email login works with UPPERCASE, lowercase, and MixedCase emails using MongoDB regex with $options: 'i', 2) KYC Settings UI in Admin Panel shows all 3 tiers with editable fee and max balance fields, 3) Save KYC Settings persists values to database and shows success toast, 4) Service card navigation from dashboard correctly opens Bills Payment with the appropriate tab active (e.g., Internet Data opens Data tab), 5) Admin user edit modal properly shows Admin/Suspended/Blocked checkboxes with correct state initialization

case_insensitive_email_login.details: Login with 'ADMIN@SMSRELAY.COM' (uppercase) successfully authenticates and redirects to dashboard. Also tested with lowercase and mixed case emails.

kyc_settings_admin_ui.details: Admin Panel > KYC Settings shows all 3 tiers with Verification Fee (NGN) and Maximum Wallet Balance (NGN) fields. UI includes helpful text like 'Users exceeding this will be suspended'.

save_kyc_settings.details: Updating tier fee/balance values and clicking 'Save KYC Settings' persists changes to database. Success toast 'KYC tier settings saved!' is displayed. Values persist after page refresh.

service_card_navigation.details: Clicking 'Internet Data' card from dashboard Quick Services section navigates to Bills Payment with Data tab active, showing 'Buy Data Bundle' form with network selection.

admin_user_toggle.details: Admin Panel > Users > Edit shows modal with Admin checkbox properly initialized. Checkbox state is correctly bound to editUser state and can be toggled.
